test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_countmin_string_stats_src( c1 UInt64, c2 String, c3 String, c4 String, c5 String, c6 LowCardinality(String), c7 LowCardinality(String), c8 LowCardinality(String), c9 LowCardinality(String)) ENGINE = Memory;

CREATE TABLE t_countmin_stats_string_{materialize}( c1 UInt64, c2 String STATISTICS(countmin), c3 String STATISTICS(countmin), c4 String STATISTICS(countmin), c5 String STATISTICS(countmin)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1 SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0;

CREATE TABLE t_countmin_stats_low_cardinality_{materialize}( c1 UInt64, c2 LowCardinality(String) STATISTICS(countmin), c3 LowCardinality(String) STATISTICS(countmin), c4 LowCardinality(String) STATISTICS(countmin), c5 LowCardinality(String) STATISTICS(countmin)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1 SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0;
CREATE TABLE t_countmin_numeric_stats_src( c1 UInt64, c2 UInt32, c3 UInt32, c4 LowCardinality(UInt32), c5 LowCardinality(UInt32)) ENGINE = Memory;

CREATE TABLE t_countmin_stats_numeric_{materialize}( c1 UInt64, c2 UInt32 STATISTICS(countmin), c3 UInt32 STATISTICS(countmin)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1 SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0;

CREATE TABLE t_countmin_stats_low_cardinality_numeric_{materialize}( c1 UInt64, c2 LowCardinality(UInt32) STATISTICS(countmin), c3 LowCardinality(UInt32) STATISTICS(countmin)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1 SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0;
CREATE TABLE t_countmin_nullable_string_stats_src( c1 UInt64, c2 Nullable(String), c3 LowCardinality(Nullable(String))) ENGINE = Memory;

CREATE TABLE t_countmin_stats_nullable_string_{materialize}( c1 UInt64, c2 Nullable(String) STATISTICS(countmin)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1 SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0;

CREATE TABLE t_countmin_stats_low_cardinality_nullable_string_{materialize}( c1 UInt64, c2 LowCardinality(Nullable(String)) STATISTICS(countmin)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1 SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0;
CREATE TABLE t_countmin_large_dictionary_stats_src( c1 UInt64, c2 LowCardinality(UInt32)) ENGINE = Memory;

CREATE TABLE t_countmin_stats_low_cardinality_large_dictionary_{materialize}( c1 UInt64, c2 LowCardinality(UInt32) STATISTICS(countmin)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1 SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0;
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_countmin_string_stats_src SELECT number, toString(number % 10), toString(number % 100), toString(number % 1000), toString(number % 100000), toString(number % 10), toString(number % 100), toString(number % 1000), toString(number % 100000) FROM numbers(1000000)

INSERT INTO t_countmin_numeric_stats_src SELECT number, toUInt32(if(number < 400000, 42, number)), toUInt32(number % 100000), toUInt32(if(number < 400000, 42, number)), toUInt32(number % 100000) FROM numbers(1000000)

INSERT INTO t_countmin_nullable_string_stats_src SELECT number, multiIf(number % 10 = 0, CAST(NULL, 'Nullable(String)'), number % 10 = 1, '', 'apple'), multiIf(number % 10 = 0, CAST(NULL, 'Nullable(String)'), number % 10 = 1, '', 'apple') FROM numbers(1000000)
INSERT INTO t_countmin_large_dictionary_stats_src SELECT number, toUInt32(number) FROM numbers(1000000)
